facts.fact: The New Times reports that Benin completed the first phase of a Smart Africa pilot connecting its national digital identity system through the Smart Africa Data Exchange for cross-border identity verification, using synthetic data in a controlled test; live use is not yet possible.

The New Times reports that Ghana completed the first phase of a Smart Africa pilot connecting its national digital identity system through the Smart Africa Data Exchange for cross-border identity verification, using synthetic data in a controlled test; live use is not yet possible.

The New Times reports that Rwanda completed the first phase of a Smart Africa pilot connecting its national digital identity system through the Smart Africa Data Exchange for cross-border identity verification, using synthetic data in a controlled test; live use is not yet possible.
